summary: C3is Inc., a Greek-incorporated Nasdaq-listed dry bulk/shipping foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 press release announcing a one-for-five reverse stock split approved by its board within a stockholder-authorized ratio range. The split takes effect 11:59 pm ET November 8, 2026, with split-adjusted Nasdaq trading opening November 9, 2026, reducing outstanding shares from roughly 4.2 million to 0.84 million; par value and CUSIP change to Y18284508. Warrants and Series A Convertible Preferred adjust proportionately, with Class B and C warrants subject to a further adjustment period. Purpose is remedying Nasdaq's minimum bid price deficiency; fractional shares are cashed out. Watch for post-split trading and any delisting-compliance update.
